passages.quote:
The DVS provides services for public sector organisations, including property advice and valuations.

They offer services to specific parts of the public sector:

central and local government

healthcare

educational bodies

transport

emergency services

environmental organisations

Central and local government

The DVS provides specific services to central and local government.

Policy development and analysis

advice on development plans and strategies

property market analyses and reports

Housing

development appraisals

negotiating affordable housing mixes, values and commuted sum payments

section 106 agreements and issues (Section 75 Scotland)

portfolio reviews and stock valuations

Right to Buy valuations

Commercial development

compulsory purchase and compensation

developer selection and negotiations

land assembly issues

apportionment of proceeds between development partners

overage, escalator and claw back

Healthcare sector (NHS)

In addition to providing general property valuations and advice, the DVS also provides the NHS with the following services:

preparation of project documentation for business cases

Official Journal of the European Union (OJEU) advertising and private finance initiative (PFI) project briefs

primary care premises development services

Current Market Rent assessments of GP practices under the NHS Directions

advising on capital funding allocations for NHS dentistry

LIFT Market Value transfers and value for money (VFM) reports

advice on residual value amounts and bullet payments

Educational bodies

The DVS provides advice on a range of educational properties including:

student halls of residence

student accommodation

administration and teaching blocks

lecture theatres

leisure facilities

Transport

The DVS provides advice on new road, rail, tram and pipeline schemes, and on airport expansions and new runways.

The services they offer this sector, include:

advice on route selection

initial estimates of acquisition and compensation costs

market and land price change forecasts and reports

Compulsory purchase and compensation

The DVS also offers the transport sector:

expert witnesses at CPO inquiries, lands tribunal and alternative dispute resolution hearings

negotiation and handling of all types of compensation claims under compulsory purchase order (CPO) powers including blight notice, severance, injurious affection and disturbance

advice on section 17 and 18 Land Compensation Act 1961

easements, wayleaves and licences

Emergency services

The DVS provides property services to support the needs of the emergency services.

Read the guide Services provided by the District Valuer Service (DVS) for more information.
